baseline_findings.finding: The baseline authored road is a single rectangular PlaneGeometry(ROAD_WIDTH, ROAD_LENGTH), so it cannot establish a connected bend or circuit direction.
The baseline guardrail is pinned to one constant local X (RAIL_X=-3.62) instead of deriving from a course-relative barrier line, reinforcing a roadside rather than racetrack read.

TrackWorld intentionally retains the legacy wide TechnicalTrackWorld ground as a lowered backing plane. Final visual QA must confirm no broad apron/backing seam remains visible after racetrack integration.

Baseline landscape uses broad world-space grass planes and generic enclosing belts rather than the new course-relative landscape exclusion contract; integrated QA must confirm greenery reads as infield/outside terrain rather than random roadside scenery.
